text:
Maya Patel: Quick debrief from today's SparkRoom marketplace launch — thanks everyone who jumped in. Two asks: 1) finalize the benchmark narrative for the partner blog by EOD Fri, 2) confirm inbound lead routing + demo slots for the partner cohort. Notes below.

Tony Liu: Re: routing — proposed mapping: marketplace listing -> lead_source='sparkroom_marketplace' -> route to Cloud AE queue -> 24hr SLA. See draft rule: 
```
if lead.source == 'sparkroom_marketplace':
  if lead.ARR > 500000: assign('AE - Enterprise')
  elif lead.ARR > 100000: assign('AE - Cloud')
  else: assign('Inbound - SDR nurture')
```
Need thumbs on ARR buckets and if we should add a lead_score cutoff.

Elaine R.: Uploaded partner tile assets + logos to shared folder: https://drive.redwood/sparkroom/assets (png/svg). Also added UTM template and the tracking sheet: https://drive.redwood/sparkroom/tracking. I put the routing CSV draft in "routing-matrix.csv".

Jules Moreno: Blog draft here: https://docs.redwood/sparkroom-blog-draft — framed the benchmark narrative around cost-per-token and tail latency improvements vs baseline. Placeholder table for numbers (please paste ENG numbers into the 'benchmarks' table). Also added a short FAQ for marketplace listing copy.

Samir Khan: Sales side: we'll prioritize demo invites to inbound leads with ARR > 100k and intent tag 'integration'. Need the filtered CSV by Monday. I can host two demo slots next Wed/Thu 11:00am PST — will handle invites if we confirm time.

DevOps Bot: Calendar event created: "SparkRoom Partner Demo — cohort A" Wed 2026-04-07 11:00 PST. Link: https://calendar.redwood/event/12345

Tony Liu: UTM convention proposal: utm_source=sparkroom&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=sparkroom_launch_v1. Recommend partner append redirect that preserves these params and includes hidden field lead_source=marketplace on our form.

Elaine R.: Routing CSV draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood/sparkroom/routing-matrix.csv — columns: email, company, ARR_bucket, lead_score, utm_campaign. See sheet tab 'AutoAssign' for queue logic and comments. Added a column 'preferred_demo_time' to help scheduling.

Maya Patel: Small copy ask for the blog intro — current draft: "How we cut inference cost by 2.3x for SparkRoom workflows". Can we reduce 'we' language and be more product/outcome focused? Suggest: "Inference cost reduced 2.3x for SparkRoom workflow benchmarks". Jules pls iterate.

Jules Moreno: Updated intro pushed to the doc. Also added a quote placeholder for SparkRoom PM @alex.sparks — can someone from partner ops ping them for approval and a 1-2 sentence blurb?

Samir Khan: @Elaine can you add the SF-based demo team in AutoAssign for ARR>500k? We'll take enterprise opps.

Elaine R.: Done. AutoAssign now maps ARR>500k -> 'AE - Enterprise' queue. Added comments in the sheet for fallback logic. @Tony please review before we flip automation.

Tony Liu: Reviewed and approved. ETA to flip automation monday 9:00am PST.

Maya Patel: Final checklist for Monday: blog draft ready? (Jules) | benchmark numbers inserted? (Eng) | assets uploaded? (Elaine) | routing automation go-live? (Tony/EngOps) | demo invites scheduled? (Samir). I'll compile the launch thread after we confirm. :rocket: 

Samir Khan: +1. If we get the filtered CSV by EOD Mon I can seed cohort invites same day.

Maya Patel: Thanks all — please add any blockers here.

(Reaction note: several :thumbsup: on the doc link, 2 people added calendar RSVP)
